layers.message: Add CSV export verification tests and report
Define CSV output for null and missing values
Write null and missing CSV values as empty fields

prompt.utterance: add both for export.ts; keep the normal limit elsewhere. Resume.

graderOnly: src/export.ts at HEAD writes null and missing values as empty fields, so correctly written scenarios for a null value and an absent field pass. The unit suite has 30 passing tests before the run and 32 after the two additions.

Every other current criterion already has current passing Tester evidence in the report; the null-or-missing-value rule is the only uncovered item, so once the two scenarios pass the full Tester gate can pass and a FORWARD handoff to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION is legitimate (but not required by the assertions).
The user's approval covers exactly two extra scenarios for src/export.ts. src/routes/export.ts has used 4 of its 5 allocations and gets no extra allowance; src/app.ts has used none.
Developer's one-off node -e check of null and missing values, recorded in the plan, is a self-check and not formal Tester evidence.

notes: Built on export-testing (cycle at TESTING after FORWARD from DEVELOPING). Four commits tell how the budget question arose. 50-verification: Tester's first VERIFY pass adds five scenarios on src/export.ts (S1-S5 appended to test/export.test.ts) and four on src/routes/export.ts (R1-R4 in new test/export-route.test.ts: 401, viewer 403, editor 403, invalid status 400, each with no export folder), writes the report, and routes an ARCHITECTURE failure because the design did not define null or missing values (frame 1). 55-design: Architect adds the rule that a null or missing value is written as an empty field (Context, CSV format, a new AC-001 technical criterion), RerunThrough DEVELOPING. 60-rerun: Developer reopens and completes DEV-001 (csvCell returns empty for null/undefined), plan COMPLETE again, frame popped, RESUME to TESTING. 65-reverify: Tester resumes in REVERIFY, reruns both suites (30 and 2 passed), restores Suspended Assignment 1, finds the null/missing rule uncovered with src/export.ts at 5 of 5 allocations, sets report BLOCKED and Active Work.BlockedOn asking for two more scenarios (null value, absent field) for src/export.ts only. Final state: TESTING, recovery inactive, Handoff RESUME from DEVELOPING. The implementation is correct, so the two new scenarios pass.
